findings.issue: The same stale naming remains in private helpers retyped to `IsFullLattice`: `exists_isLattice_padicLocalization_eq` (its public companion was renamed to `existsUnique_isFullLattice_padicLocalization_eq`), `isLattice_splitCarrier` (`IntegralLattice/Milgram.lean:182`) and `isLattice_neighborCarrier` (`IntegralLattice/Neighbor/Isotropic.lean:172`, used as a local instance).

summary: The PR now renames almost every declaration retyped to `IsFullLattice`, but one public theorem and three private helpers still carry `IsLattice` names that point to Mathlib's weaker notion or its deprecated alias. Rename them to match the rest of the PR.
